content.comment_body: Hello, I'm encountering communication issues between two [product_name] modules. Both devices, model [article_no], are connected via an ethernet switch to a PC running [product_name] software. I followed an online video tutorial to set up inter-device communication in a network project. The system behaves as intended during simulation: an input on one module successfully triggers an output on the other. However, after downloading the program using diagram mode, the input activates in online mode when powered, but the corresponding output on the second device does not respond. Additionally, I am unable to run both of them online at the same time. Any advice would be helpful.
You are working with the latest [version_no] modules. For successful communication, you need to enable S7 access. To do this, go to File > Properties > Offline settings > General.

analysis.insight_summary: Users report that communication between two [product_name] modules works as expected in simulation but fails when deployed on actual hardware. Outputs on the second device do not activate as intended in live operation, pointing to issues with network or access configuration. Lack of knowledge about essential option changes, like enabling S7 access for newer hardware versions, is contributing to persistent setup problems.
analysis.user_expectations: User expects communication between both [product_name] modules to function the same as the simulation, with consistent online monitoring and control capabilities for both devices through the [product_name] software.
